name: Amartey Bekoe & Co.
description: Editorial one-page site for a Ghanaian firm of chartered accountants, in the style of an annual report: paper, ink and audit navy with a red-pen tick, Newsreader headings with IBM Plex Sans and Mono, square corners and ruled lines. It has a 'firm at a glance' ledger, a captioned black-and-white photo plate, an expandable numbered services index, a live key-dates table (SSNIT, PAYE, VAT, quarterly tax, annual return), industries, a dark quote and figures band, audit stages, black-and-white partner portraits, notes, three offices with open-now status, and a request-a-proposal form tagged by service.
